hero.subtext: Experienced doctors, a modern dental chair and an in-house lab. Book your appointment on WhatsApp and skip the waiting room.

about.title: Meet Dr. Sharma & team
about.text:
Dr. A. K. Sharma (MBBS, MD) and Dr. Ritu Sharma (BDS, MDS) have cared for families in Prayagraj for over 12 years.

Our clinic follows strict sterilisation protocols, keeps digital records of every visit and sends reports straight to your WhatsApp.

services.name: General Consultation
services.description: Fever, BP, diabetes, thyroid and everyday health problems.

services.name: Dental Check-up & Cleaning
services.description: Full check-up, scaling and polishing for healthy gums.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment
services.description: Painless single-sitting RCT with digital X-ray.

services.name: Child Care
services.description: Vaccinations, growth checks and care for common childhood illnesses.

services.name: Lab Tests
services.description: Blood sugar, CBC, lipid profile, thyroid and more. Reports on WhatsApp.

services.name: Health Check Package
services.description: 40+ tests with a doctor's review, ideal for adults above 30.

testimonials.name: Kavita D.
testimonials.text: Booking on WhatsApp saved me an hour of waiting. Reports came on my phone the same evening.

faq.a: Walk-ins are welcome, but appointments get priority. Book on WhatsApp to get a time slot.

faq.q: Is the clinic open on Sunday?
faq.a: The clinic is closed on Sunday. For emergencies, please call the phone number given above.
We provide bills and reports for reimbursement claims. Cashless facility is not available.

faq.q: How do I get my lab reports?
faq.a: Reports are sent to your WhatsApp number and printed copies are available at the clinic.
